dataset_manifest.policy: Exact aligned fields and ordered exact words within reviewed notes and validation-date text use fitted geometry. Uncertain background and conflicting roles are masked; independently verified exact positives are retained. Whole-field exactness is measured separately. Original OCR text and all reviewed targets are preserved.

sealed.policy: Reviewed values and image digests only: no OCR, metrics or inspection until the candidate is frozen (docs/next-ver-plan.md §5.4, rule 4).

manifest.checkpoint_selection: validation whole-field accuracy, then non-note word F1, then word micro F1
